text.tspan: Share living on less than $8.30 a day vs. mean income or consumption

tspan.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.tspan: The poverty line of $8.30 per day is set by the World Bank to be representative of the definitions of poverty adopted in
upper-middle-income countries. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes
